g.text: Candidate pruning fraction for the two ALNS solvers
Source: independent_v1/main_* only; 90 held-out instances (45 small / 30 medium / 15 large). Seeds averaged within instance, then instances equally
weighted within each scale. 95% instance-bootstrap intervals; omitted for n<2 or constant samples. All runs included.
